verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a compliance case-management SaaS that uses automation and agents, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers APIs, attachments, filings, audit trails and exports, but has no statement on AI model training, data-use policy or any opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
